events.title: First Person: Syrians lead efforts to clear rubble and rebuild lives
events.summary: Communities in Syria are clearing rubble and rebuilding neighbourhoods and livelihoods torn down in the more than a decade of conflict and crisis in the country.

events.title: Former rebel fighters join campaign against Ebola in the DR Congo
events.summary: Demobilised former combatants are actively joining the fight against Ebola by participating in public information campaigns in the east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

events.title: 900 obstacles and counting: West Bank families trapped as aid access shrinks
events.summary: Humanitarians continue to provide life-saving assistance to people across the Occupied Palestinian Territory despite facing obstacles such as checkpoints, instability and access restrictions, the United Nations said on Friday.

events.title: An attack on healthcare every six hours, and no one held to account

events.title: Sudan: The harrowing reality of giving birth in a war zone
events.summary: Sudanese women about to give birth are losing their babies and sometimes their own lives because of a lack of specialist healthcare support, amid the ongoing war, UN humanitarians said on Friday.

events.title: Gaza: Destruction of buildings rises by nearly 10 per cent since ceasefire
events.summary: New satellite assessments show the destruction of buildings in Gaza has climbed by nearly 10 per cent since October’s faltering ceasefire between Hamas and Israeli forces aim to end the two-year war, which reduced cities to rubble and disp...

events.title: Ukraine: Civilian casualties hit highest level since March 2022
events.summary: Civilian casualties in Ukraine reached their highest monthly level in July, with more people killed and injured than at any time since March 2022, the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in the country, HRMMU, said in an update on Thursday.

events.title: Security Council LIVE: Escalating attacks threaten peace in Yemen

events.title: Occupied West Bank: Settler siege of Palestinians marks a new low
events.summary: In the occupied West Bank, the UN human rights office, OHCHR, appealed on Thursday to Israeli authorities to help Palestinian families trapped in their homes by settlers for days, amid an intensifying campaign to seize their land.

events.title: Sudan: Attacks and further displacement in Blue Nile and North Kordofan
events.summary: The United Nations has once again urged warring parties in Sudan to protect civilians as the fighting continues to take a heavy toll on the population.

events.title: Deadly attack on Red Sea ship adds to global supply chain uncertainty

events.title: South Sudan: UN mission decries deadly attacks, works to calm tensions after ‘nothing but devastation’
events.summary: The UN Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS) has condemned recent armed group attacks in Warrap state which reportedly left more than 60 civilians dead and 50 others injured.

events.title: Security Council LIVE: Spotlight on Israeli settler violence in West Bank
events.summary: The Security Council held an open debate on Tuesday which is expected to address escalating Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank as attacks on Palestinians and their property continue. UN News app users can follow here.

events.title: Fighting deepens needs and fuels further displacement in Sudan
events.summary: Ongoing conflict, displacement and funding shortages continue to deepen needs in Sudan, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) warned on Monday, underscoring the need for greater civilian protection.

events.title: Lebanon: UN peacekeepers count hundreds of Israeli strikes and incursions in a single weekend
events.summary: Israeli forces fired 455 projectiles into south Lebanon and breached Lebanese airspace 97 times between Friday and Sunday, the UN's peacekeeping mission in the country reported Monday – among the heaviest fire seen in months.

events.title: Humanitarian aid warehouses come under attack in Ukraine
events.summary: Russia’s ongoing full-scale invasion of Ukraine has left civilians vulnerable to repeated deadly attacks and humanitarian workers and key facilities being targeted and destroyed.

events.title: Sudan: ‘It made me dream again’: The students refusing to let war stop their education
events.summary: Sarah Tekhlu was ready to give up on university. An Eritrean refugee, she had already been displaced once from Khartoum to Madani, then again to Port Sudan, as war tore through the country around her. Higher education, she had decided, was...

events.title: ‘Sudan is losing another generation’ to war, Mohammed warns
events.summary: More than 1,000 days of war in Sudan have left millions of children out of school, displaced or exposed to grave violations, the UN Deputy Secretary-General said on Friday, calling for renewed action to end the conflict.

events.title: ‘A clear violation’: Guterres deplores deadliest attack on Kyiv this year
events.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres condemned on Wednesday the deadliest Russian strikes on Kyiv this year, which killed 17 people and caused extensive damage to civilian infrastructure overnight.

events.title: Cuba: Independent experts condemn new US sanctions as humanitarian crisis deepens
events.summary: Independent UN human rights experts on Thursday condemned a fresh round of US sanctions against Cuba, calling them an attempt to force change on “a sovereign State through threats and coercion.”

events.title: ‘Wanton, intentional infliction of incredible pain’ by gangs in Haiti
events.summary: Gangs in Haiti continue to terrorise communities with the “wanton, intentional infliction of incredible pain” on people who often are just in the wrong place at the wrong time.

events.title: Security Council LIVE: Warnings of famine and collapse as South Sudan's peace deal frays
events.summary: Nearly eight million people in South Sudan – more than half the population – face crisis-level hunger, with famine risk now flagged in four counties, as the Security Council met this morning in New York. A cholera outbreak has killed more...

events.title: Gaza: 300 children killed in 300 days of Israeli-Hamas ‘ceasefire’
events.summary: At least 300 children in Gaza have been reportedly killed in as many days since a ceasefire agreement supposedly came into effect last October to suspend military operations between Hamas fighters and the Israel Defense Forces, the UN Chil...

events.title: Hiroshima fosters hope, 81 years on from nuclear catastrophe
events.summary: Eighty-one years ago on Thursday, the United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, reducing the city to ruins, killing tens of thousands of people and bringing the world “face to face with the catastrophic power of nuclear war”.

events.title: UN reports deadly month for Ukrainian civilians as Russian attacks intensify
events.summary: Russian forces hammered Ukraine with ballistic missiles and long-range drones overnight on Tuesday, killing at least 17 civilians – mainly around Kyiv – and injuring another 44, the UN human rights office in Ukraine reported.

events.title: Gaza ‘unsafe for civilians’ as Israeli attacks hit homes and classrooms
events.summary: Gaza remains unsafe for civilians as Israeli attacks continue, including on schools and canvas classrooms, despite the October Israel-Hamas ceasefire that ended two years of war, the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCH...

events.title: ‘A playground, a beach, a home’: UNICEF demands end to child deaths in Russia-Ukraine war

events.title: Strait of Hormuz disruption hits energy, fertilizer and industrial trade
events.summary: Disruption in the Strait of Hormuz has exposed the vulnerability of global trade to a single maritime chokepoint, with early data showing sharp falls in exports of energy, fertilizers and industrial products.
